The '''A295 sniper rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] developed by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The weapon was used by [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]].
